brief: The canvas displays a cross-section of fertile earth, represented by bands of mottled, earthy color. Scattered across the field are geometric representations of planted crops and stylized tools. When the cursor is dragged across the surface, it simulates plowing: a line of rich green particles is drawn, spreading and transforming into small, dark seed shapes embedded in the ground. Clicking anywhere on the canvas sends a luminous pulse that spreads outward, causing the embedded seeds to animate and rise up in bursts of varying heights, mimicking growth. The whole scene possesses a subtle, slow pulse of color and movement, representing the cyclical rhythm of the seasons.
